description:
Proposed Internal Works: The proposal seeks to convert the existing first floor office into a one bedroom residential flat, with works confined entirely to the interior at first floor level.
Internal alterations: The proposed one bedroom flat will be arranged into four distinct zones, accessed via a small existing entrance lobby.
1. Front Living area with storage and a study niche. No alteration to window openings or historic fabric
2. Central Dining, Kitchen Area. Kitchen Units proposed on both walls. Kitchen appliances requiring drainage connect to the existing soil vent pipe within the bathroom. Kitchen units backing onto the bathroom includes: Dishwasher and Kitchen sink. The kitchen units on the party wall side will not require drainage. The units house the fridge, oven and hob.
3. Bathroom, the existing WC cubicle and kitchenette will be combined to form a single bathroom with WC (in the same position), basin, shower and washing machine, retaining the same soil and waste connections
4. Double Bedroom, a 30 minute fire resisting stud partition and door will be installed to form the bedroom
with built in bedroom wardrobes (approximately 5.5 linear metres)
Note Storage built in cupboards and shelves will be though out the flat an existing storage cupboard on the first floor landing under the stairs to the upper level, which could be used for storage and refuse if required.
